questions.def: Use the past simple tense to describe completed actions in the past.
questions.question: Yesterday, I ___ to the store.

questions.def: Past perfect continuous shows an activity continuing before another past action.
questions.question: He ___ playing video games all day.

questions.def: Past perfect describes an action completed before another in the past.
questions.question: They ___ in London before moving to Paris.

questions.def: Past continuous describes an ongoing action interrupted by another past action.
questions.question: While I ___, she called me.

questions.def: Past perfect describes an action completed before another action in the past.
questions.question: By the time we arrived, they ___ all the food.

questions.def: 'Yesterday' needs past simple: went.
questions.question: I am go to the cinema yesterday evening.

questions.def: Past perfect shows a completed duration before another past event.
questions.question: He ___ at the company for five years before he quit.

questions.def: Past simple is used for finished events in the past.
questions.question: She ___ the door and left.

questions.def: Past continuous shows intention in the past.
questions.question: They ___ to the party, but they decided not to.

questions.def: Past continuous shows interrupted actions in the past.
questions.question: She ___ a cake when the guests arrived.

questions.def: Past simple for the second action after 'before'.
questions.question: Before she ___ to bed, she brushed her teeth.

questions.def: 'Would' is the past form of 'will' in reported speech.
questions.question: He said he ___ come.

questions.def: Past simple to express a past desire.
questions.question: I ___ to go to the cinema last night.

questions.def: Past perfect to show the movie began before the arrival.
questions.question: The movie ___ when we arrived.

questions.def: 'Were' agrees with 'you' in the past continuous question.
questions.question: What ___ you doing last night?

questions.def: Past simple to describe seeing someone in the past.
questions.question: I ___ him at the party last weekend.

questions.def: 'Was' is the past simple form of 'be' for singular subjects.
questions.question: She ___ very happy yesterday.

questions.def: Past continuous shows an action in progress when interrupted.
questions.question: They ___ dinner when the phone rang.

questions.def: 'Last year' needs past simple: visited.
questions.question: He has visited Paris last year.

questions.def: Past perfect shows an action completed before another past action.
questions.question: By the time I got there, the show ___.

questions.def: Use past simple to describe how you felt in the past.
questions.question: I ___ tired after working all day.

questions.def: 'Would' is the past form of 'will' in reported speech.
questions.question: She said she ___ call me later.

questions.def: Past simple for a completed action in the past.
questions.question: I ___ for you for an hour yesterday.

questions.def: 'Were' is the past simple form of 'be' for plural subjects.
questions.question: They ___ happy to see us.

questions.def: Past perfect needs 'had' + past participle.
questions.question: He ___ already left when I arrived.

questions.def: Past simple 'went' describes a completed action in the past.
questions.question: Yesterday, I ___ to the store to buy milk.

questions.def: Past continuous (was watching) + past simple (rang) for interrupted actions.
questions.question: While I was watching TV, the phone ___.

questions.def: 'Had eaten' is the past perfect form, not 'had ate'.
questions.question: She had ate all the cookies before I arrived.

questions.def: Past perfect continuous for an action lasting until another past action.
questions.question: I ___ for the bus for 30 minutes.

questions.def: Past perfect 'had started' shows a completed action before another past action.
questions.question: By the time we got to the cinema, the film ___ already ___.
